items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Keep searchwoot.com private. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access but not public/commercial redistribution rights; Woot terms restrict collection, listings, prices, and derivative use; four launch-readiness tasks remain open; accuracy, security, measurement, attribution, and owner gates are incomplete. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, permission request, affiliate use, advertising use, or alert expansion. Technical compliance is not certification: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Incomplete telemetry alone is not a general fleet launch blocker.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Existing progress includes official Woot API, terms, and support evidence; repository/configuration artifacts; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft terms. No task closes because rights, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy, freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep outreach unsent.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivative/alert use, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized permission request. User alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Smallest next action: capture deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, and retention settings without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and data-request inventory.

For ordinary fleet work, retain a conditional disposition rather than a blanket block: reversible SEO, UX, content, and affiliate maintenance may proceed only within existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries, with no new tracking, credentials, dependencies, monetization expansion, or external outreach. Do not treat the analytics yellow status, aggregate revenue, or incomplete telemetry as zero or as proof of legal clearance. The $4.92 Amazon commission for 2026-09-21 remains aggregate and unattributed.
